_about: A pick list for the Add Service Choose screen, not evidence. Nothing here is read from a car or decoded from a VIN; a value picked from it is stored as typed in ('chosen from the list'). Models are the North American market only. 'basis' says where each entry came from. A model or engine that could not be stated with confidence is left out; the person can use the Other option and type it. last_year null means still current (the page then lists up to next calendar year).
